He highlights strong mid- and small-cap earnings growth, reliable SIP inflows, and easing FPI selling, while cautioning against risks like rising crude prices and currency fluctuations.

items.title: Delhi rains: IndiGo, Air India issue travel advisory as weather conditions disrupt flight ops at IGI Airport
items.summary: Heavy rain lashed Delhi and surrounding areas on Saturday morning. Several airlines issued advisories to passengers regarding potential flight delays at Indira Gandhi International Airport. Bad weather conditions are currently affecting flight operations and causing disruptions. Traffic movement across the national capital was also impacted by waterlogging. Authorities advised passengers to check flight status and allow extra travel time.

items.title: Gold reserves are on the move, but central banks are choosing different vaults
items.summary: The world’s gold is changing vaults. The Netherlands is shifting bullion to London, France has moved holdings out of New York, while India now keeps 77% of RBI gold at home. The moves reveal how central banks are rethinking where their ultimate crisis asset should sit.

items.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent sees crude oil as low as $40 post-Iran war, lower bond yields
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent anticipates oil prices will fall significantly after the Iran conflict concludes. He expects crude oil to reach as low as forty dollars a barrel due to oversupply. This decline in oil prices will subsequently lower bond yields, which have recently surged. Bessent also downplayed Norway's sovereign wealth fund proposal to reduce Treasury holdings.

items.summary: In its ambitious IPO initiative, Rentomojo targets a valuation of ₹4,246 crore, while securing ₹150 crore in fresh funding. Additionally, existing investors plan to divest shares valued at ₹1,106 crore through an offer for sale. Impressively, the startup reported a 142% jump in net profit, which reached ₹104.3 crore in FY26. Mark your calendars, as the IPO launches on September 9.

items.title: Capital market stocks rise on CAS fix hopes, index closes 1% higher
items.summary: Capital market stocks saw gains Friday after regulator Sebi's circular on the Closing Auction Session mechanism. Trader pushback against CAS-linked settlement pricing prompted Sebi to respond to market concerns. Erratic settlement prints since August 3 caused option premiums to swing significantly. Market participants anticipate Sebi's paper will reduce reliance on the single CAS print. This move is expected to restore trader confidence and remove trading volume overhang.

items.title: Nifty ends below 24,000 for 4th week of losses
items.summary: Indian equity markets faced a downturn for the fourth straight week, with the Nifty index retreating under 24,000. A combination of soaring crude oil prices and sluggish leading stocks contributed to the bleak market outlook. Analysts suggest the Nifty is likely to hover in a limited range without significant catalysts.

items.title: No tax tangle, FPIs keen to move G-Sec money next day
items.summary: Foreign investors are advocating for expedited remittance processes after the Indian government introduced tax exemptions on bonds. They are calling on regulators and banks to enhance the speed of money transfers. This initiative aims to streamline remittance operations and mitigate settlement delays, as the exemption abolishes withholding taxes on interest and capital gains from these investments, improving market efficiency for foreign portfolio investors.

items.title: RBI turns to longer-dated VRRR for liquidity mop-up
items.summary: In an effort to control escalating inflation, the Reserve Bank of India is running auctions to draw in surplus liquidity from the financial system. This move comes as call money rates fall beneath the policy repo rate, with predictions indicating liquidity levels could exceed fifteen lakh crore by the close of September. Additionally, the central bank recently sold government securities worth thirty-two thousand crore.

items.title: Dollar bounces on job gains, then pares ahead of CPI
items.summary: The U.S. job market showed surprising resilience in August, adding 162,000 positions—far beyond what analysts anticipated. This result has led to heightened expectations for a Federal Reserve rate increase in September. However, the dollar softened slightly as traders now focus on looming inflation reports. Wages saw a year-over-year uptick of 3.1%, the weakest growth since June 2021, while the yen appreciated against the dollar throughout the week.

items.title: Gold slides after robust US payrolls boosts rate hike bets
items.summary: Gold prices experienced a downturn on Friday, setting the stage for a weekly loss as solid US job data raised the bar for anticipated rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. This shift has rendered the non-yielding precious metal less desirable. Alongside gold, silver and platinum also saw drops. Investors are now keenly awaiting inflation updates for insights into policy adjustments.

items.title: Oil ends week higher on renewed US-Iran strikes, diesel hits record
items.summary: Oil prices have surged dramatically this week amidst escalating military tensions between the U.S. and Iran. Record-high retail diesel prices in the U.S. are fueling global inflation concerns. Supply chain disruptions in the Middle East are dealing a blow to crude oil futures. Analysts warn of potential further increases if the conflict deepens. Additionally, positive U.S. employment figures could encourage the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates soon.

items.title: European shares log weekly losses on inflation worries; Volkswagen jumps
items.summary: European markets wrapped up the week with a dip, influenced by ongoing Middle East tensions and persistent inflation apprehensions. A positive turn from Volkswagen shares provided some needed support after they revealed a new strategic plan. Investors are now keenly awaiting US inflation metrics to gauge potential shifts in the Federal Reserve's interest rate stance.

items.summary: US job growth data boosted Federal Reserve rate hike expectations. Treasury yields and the dollar strengthened after the positive jobs report. Major US stock indexes and global stocks experienced a broad selloff. Oil prices rose due to renewed attacks in the US-Iran war. Investors now await inflation data before the Fed's September decision.

items.title: PUBG-fame Krafton to invest another $250 million in India as it expands beyond gaming
items.summary: Krafton, the creator of BGMI, plans to invest an additional $250 million in India over the next few years, doubling its total investment. The South Korean gaming company has backed numerous startups and continues to strengthen its local operations.

items.title: Wall Street Week Ahead:Investors to pore over inflation data for signals on rate trajectory
items.summary: Investors await crucial inflation data next week which may decide the Fed's interest rate move. The S&P 500 index is nearing its record high while facing market volatility. Producer and Consumer Price Index reports will offer insights into August's inflation trends. Odds for a Fed rate hike are currently around a coin flip. Treasury yields and AI trade developments also remain key market concerns.

items.title: Nitin Gadkari allows old vehicle owners to fit a Rs 5,000 device to bring BS-III, BS-IV diesel trucks, buses closer to BS-VI emission levels
items.summary: Union Road Transport Minister Nitin Gadkari has announced that owners of old diesel trucks and buses will be allowed to retrofit their vehicles with a low-cost emission-control device developed from an IIT-Delhi innovation. The device, priced at around Rs 4,000-5,000, can cut particulate matter emissions by up to 90% and nitrogen oxide emissions by 60%, bringing BS-III, BS-IV and older diesel vehicles close to BS-VI emission levels.

items.title: Nilgiris tea production hit by severe drought, El Nino conditions; green leaf supply drops sharply
items.summary: Severe drought conditions in Nilgiris have drastically reduced green tea leaf supply. Tea factories are experiencing significant revenue losses and production declines. Small farmers face immense hardship due to crop failure and inadequate prices. Rainfall deficits have caused a substantial drop in tea productivity across the region. Government assistance is urgently needed for affected tea growers and workers.

items.title: Jio IPO: Ambani’s tech titan listing story isn’t yet credible: View
items.summary: Mukesh Ambani is pitching Jio Platforms as more than a telecom company ahead of its IPO, highlighting thousands of patents, AI and proprietary technology. items.title: Govt flags Abhayrab rabies vaccine batch as substandard, probes if spurious, document shows
items.summary: India's drug regulator has flagged a batch of Abhayrab rabies vaccine as substandard. This finding marks the second time concerns have been raised about counterfeit Abhayrab doses. The government's Central Drugs Laboratory found the vaccine did not meet potency requirements. Significant differences were noted between the sampled product and a reference sample. The regulator is investigating whether the vaccine is spurious under Indian law.

items.summary: Bajaj Group’s EPC firm Bajel Projects is resisting the temptation to chase rapid growth even as India’s renewable energy push lifts demand for power transmission. Instead, it is picking projects carefully, sharpening execution, expanding capacity and looking overseas for better margins.

items.title: “Unbecoming of trustee”: Tata Trusts comment, says Vijay Singh; Tata Trusts say the charity commissioner said so.

items.title: Forex reserves hit record $740.8 billion, lift rupee
items.summary: By the end of August, India recorded an unprecedented $740.8 billion in foreign-exchange reserves, which has significantly fortified the value of the Indian rupee against the dollar. This development enhances public sector banks' lending potential through enhanced liquidity coverage. Despite this, state-run banks are lagging behind private ones in deposit growth, facing pressures that necessitate higher borrowings as loans continue to exceed deposits.

items.title: Phuket-Delhi flight: Probe finds hydraulic failure; pilot sacked
items.summary: A preliminary probe found a hydraulic failure on a Phuket-Delhi flight. This incident caused altitude changes and triggered warnings, injuring 24 people. The pilot-in-command was sacked after testing positive for a psychoactive substance. Air India has begun voluntary pilot testing and maintains zero tolerance. Investigators are examining the Power Transfer Unit and maintenance records.

items.title: PVR INOX executive shown door in April after probe into alleged developer kickbacks
items.summary: A senior PVR INOX executive was asked to leave in April after an internal probe. Allegations suggest kickbacks from developers involved in building cinema properties. These alleged payments reportedly occurred over several years and could total ₹200 crore. The investigation also aims to determine the full extent of the wrongdoing. The company's board has discussed these serious matters in recent meetings.

items.title: Stellantis in talks with Huawei and JAC Group for Maserati's future, sources say
items.summary: Automaker Stellantis is discussing long-term industrial cooperation for its Maserati brand. Chinese firms Huawei and JAC Group are reportedly involved in these ongoing talks. This potential partnership aims to boost production rates at Italian manufacturing plants. Maserati, which faced losses last year, will present its own strategy soon. Stellantis stated discussions occur to offer customers better mobility choices.

items.title: Kia looks to roll out multiple powertrains to meet India demand
items.summary: Kia India is preparing electric, hybrid, and CNG models for the Indian market. The company acknowledges a huge burden in predicting customer powertrain preferences. Its new Sorento SUV launches with hybrid and diesel options. Kia plans further hybrid and electric vehicle introductions by 2030. Affordability will significantly influence electrified powertrain market penetration.

items.summary: Hindustan Unilever plans to boost growth by increasing capital expenditure and focusing on key areas. The company will invest more in brands, distribution, and new product categories. Premiumization and expanding into new market spaces will drive future turnover. HUL aims to improve margins and operating efficiencies for reinvestment. This strategy targets increased consumption and a shift towards higher-value products.

Developers are actively acquiring land in prime locations due to rising demand. Consumers now seek planned neighborhoods with quality construction and modern amenities. This trend indicates a new wave of real estate growth in tier two cities.

items.title: Telco operators reject quality of service norms for 5G slicing
items.summary: Telecom operators oppose Trai's draft quality of service norms for 5G network slicing. They argue proposed resource utilization benchmarks should be entirely dropped by the regulator. Public advocacy groups, however, believe these benchmarks can be retained as safeguards. Operators state that actual customer impact is captured via speed and throughput metrics. They believe rigid cell-level thresholds create artificial network constraints and misallocate capital.

It has to be juxtaposed with the quality of life that is being provided to the people of India," the minister said, adding that government schemes on healthcare, housing, sanitation and power supply are aimed at economic growth as well as better quality of life for citizens.

items.title: Govindas get bigger safety net for Dahi Handi celebrations
items.summary: Govindas participating in Dahi Handi celebrations now have doubled accidental hospitalisation cover. This increased protection comes with an unchanged premium of seventy-five rupees per person. Over 151,000 Govindas are covered this year, an increase from last year's participation. The policy provides ten lakh rupees for accidental death or permanent total disability. Coverage extends to training sessions and travel after the festival concludes.

items.summary: The Income Tax Department is set to enhance its Annual Information Statement by incorporating additional data. This revision extends to GST returns, foreign remittances linked to mutual funds, off-market securities, and overseas investments. Furthermore, data from another taxpayer's income tax returns will be added, aiming to fortify the verification of income and transaction details for taxpayers.

items.title: Customs portal aims to curb divergent assessment practices
items.summary: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs has introduced an innovative digital repository designed to assist importers and customs brokers. This platform features a searchable database that aims to standardize practices across the nation's customs formations. By enhancing clarity on product and transaction assessments, the National Assessment Centre Portal fosters improved compliance and transparency in trade interactions.

items.title: New FTAs open big export gains across key sectors
items.summary: The introduction of eight free trade agreements heralds a new era of duty-free market access, particularly benefiting the electronics, agriculture, and gems and jewellery sectors. With India’s share in EU and UK imports being relatively low, these pacts open doors for substantial growth. Boosting export resilience and diversifying market opportunities are key advantages for Indian businesses.
